title: Tool and Die Makers
description: Analyze specifications, lay out metal stock, set up and operate machine tools, and fit and assemble parts to make and repair dies, cutting tools, jigs, fixtures, gauges, and machinists' hand tools.

tasks.text: Verify dimensions, alignments, and clearances of finished parts for conformance to specifications, using measuring instruments such as calipers, gauge blocks, micrometers, or dial indicators.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Hands-on dimensional measurement of workpieces

dwas.name: Measure dimensions of completed products or workpieces to verify conformance to specifications.
dwas.gwa_name: Estimating the Quantifiable Characteristics of Products, Events, or Information

tasks.text: Set up and operate conventional or computer numerically controlled machine tools such as lathes, milling machines, or grinders to cut, bore, grind, or otherwise shape parts to prescribed dimensions and finishes.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Metal and plastic forming equipment run by hand

dwas.name: Operate metal or plastic forming equipment.
Operate grinding equipment.

tasks.text: Visualize and compute dimensions, sizes, shapes, and tolerances of assemblies, based on specifications.
tasks.rationale: data analysis — Dimension calculations from given specs

dwas.name: Calculate dimensions of workpieces, products, or equipment.
dwas.gwa_name: Estimating the Quantifiable Characteristics of Products, Events, or Information

tasks.text: Study blueprints, sketches, models, or specifications to plan sequences of operations for fabricating tools, dies, or assemblies.
tasks.rationale: visual inspection — Blueprints need spatial reading, human verifies sequence

dwas.name: Review blueprints or other instructions to determine operational methods or sequences.

tasks.text: Fit and assemble parts to make, repair, or modify dies, jigs, gauges, and tools, using machine tools, hand tools, or welders.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physical disassembly and reassembly of parts

dwas.name: Assemble machine tools, parts, or fixtures.
Operate welding equipment.
Repair parts or assemblies.

tasks.text: Inspect finished dies for smoothness, contour conformity, and defects.
tasks.rationale: visual inspection — Material product inspection is physical and sensory

dwas.name: Inspect metal, plastic, or composite products.

tasks.text: Select metals to be used from a range of metals and alloys, based on properties such as hardness or heat tolerance.
tasks.rationale: decision support — Input material selection from specs; human approves

dwas.name: Select production input materials.

tasks.text: Lift, position, and secure machined parts on surface plates or worktables, using hoists, vises, v-blocks, or angle plates.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Rigging and lifting loads with cranes is hands-on

dwas.name: Mount materials or workpieces onto production equipment.
Lift materials or workpieces using cranes or other lifting equipment.

tasks.text: File, grind, shim, and adjust different parts to properly fit them together.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Grinding requires hands-on control and feel

dwas.name: Smooth metal surfaces or edges.
Operate grinding equipment.

tasks.text: Smooth and polish flat and contoured surfaces of parts or tools, using scrapers, abrasive stones, files, emery cloths, or power grinders.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Grinding requires hands-on control and feel

dwas.name: Polish materials, workpieces, or finished products.
Smooth metal surfaces or edges.
Operate grinding equipment.

tasks.text: Measure, mark, and scribe metal or plastic stock to lay out machining, using instruments such as protractors, micrometers, scribes, or rulers.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Marking reference points requires hands-on measurement

dwas.name: Measure materials to mark reference points, cutting lines, or other indicators.
dwas.gwa_name: Estimating the Quantifiable Characteristics of Products, Events, or Information

tasks.text: Conduct test runs with completed tools or dies to ensure that parts meet specifications, making adjustments as necessary.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Operating production equipment physically on site

dwas.name: Inspect metal, plastic, or composite products.
Conduct test runs of production equipment.

tasks.text: Design jigs, fixtures, and templates for use as work aids in the fabrication of parts or products.
tasks.rationale: decision support — AI drafts tooling; machinist and engineer verify

dwas.name: Design tools, fixtures, or other devices for production equipment.
dwas.gwa_name: Drafting, Laying Out, and Specifying Technical Devices, Parts, and Equipment

tasks.text: Cut, shape, and trim blanks or blocks to specified lengths or shapes, using power saws, power shears, rules, and hand tools.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Hands-on industrial material cutting

dwas.name: Shape metal workpieces with hammers or other small hand tools.
Cut industrial materials in preparation for fabrication or processing.

tasks.text: Set up and operate drill presses to drill and tap holes in parts for assembly.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Drilling parts requires physical tool operation

dwas.name: Drill holes in parts, equipment, or materials.

tasks.text: Develop and design new tools and dies, using computer-aided design software.
tasks.rationale: decision support — AI drafts tooling; machinist and engineer verify

dwas.name: Design tools, fixtures, or other devices for production equipment.
dwas.gwa_name: Drafting, Laying Out, and Specifying Technical Devices, Parts, and Equipment

tasks.text: Set pyrometer controls of heat-treating furnaces and feed or place parts, tools, or assemblies into furnaces to harden.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Manual temperature control adjustment

dwas.name: Feed materials or products into or through equipment.
Adjust temperature controls of ovens or other heating equipment.
